injury.short_comment: Haliburton is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers due to left hamstring tightness.
Nembhard (neck) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.
Toppin is probable to play Wednesday against the 76ers due to a left hand sprain.
Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
McConnell (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
